Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications: 
New Drawings
Amended 'S73 Alterations & Justifications' letter, received 05/05/2025. Fire Strategy Report (Rev.5, dated 01/05/2026), received 01/05/2026. Drawings 2025_127/001(Rev.C), WD-002(Rev.G), WD-004(Rev.G), WD-006(Rev.E), WD-011(Rev.E), WD-012(Rev.E), WD-102(Rev.G), 001(Rev.C), unnumbered door specification drawing (Rev.2) and Material Schedule (Rev.B), received 16/04/2026. Unnumbered 'Freestanding Guardrail' plan and photographs, received 26/03/2026. Unnumbered bollard specification, received 05/03/2026. Drawing WD-008(Rev.C), received 30/01/2026.
Previously Approved Drawings / Documents 
Amended Drawing ERM00837 - FTA001 (Rev.A), received 28/03/2025. sCover Letter, Planning Statement, Design and Access Statement, London Development Database Management, Transport Statement, Civil Engineering SuDS Report, Preliminary Bat Roost Assessment, Statement of Community Involvement, Daylight and Sunlight Report, 337-P13-00, 337-P13-01, 337-P13-02, 337-P13-03, 337-P13-04, 337-P13-05 and 337-P13-14, Received: 04/01/2022. Unnumbered Rendered Elevation, Received: 21/03/2022. 
Reason: To ensure the development is carried out in accordance with the planning permission. 
Condition : 2 - Development shall be carried out in strict accordance with the provisions of the Construction Logistics Plan approved under application P/2024/1550.
Reason: To ensure that the construction takes place in an acceptable manner and would not cause harm to neighbouring buildings or the wider area.
Condition : 3 - Development shall be carried out in strict accordance with the amended Materials Schedule (Rev.B), received on 16/04/2026 and hereby approved, and shall be maintained as such thereafter.
Reason: In order that the Council may be satisfied as to the details of the development in the interests of the visual amenity of the area and protect living conditions.
Condition : 4 - The development shall not be occupied until the off-site waste and recycling and cycle storage arrangements approved under planning permission P/2026/1020 have been implemented in full and made available to residents. These arrangements shall then be retained thereafter for purposes ancillary to the development hereby approved. 
Reason: To ensure that there are sufficient provisions at the site for waste and recycling storage and cycle parking.
Condition : 5 - A.	The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the approved 'Energy Statement' received: 04/01/2022. 
B.	Prior to first occupation of any dwelling within the development hereby approved evidence (e.g. photographs, installation contracts and As-Built certificates under the Standard Assessment Procedure/National Calculation Method) shall be submitted to the Local Planning Authority and approved in writing to show that the development has been constructed in accordance with the approved Energy Strategy.
Reason: To ensure that the development makes the fullest contribution to minimising carbon dioxide emissions.
Condition : 6 - Prior to first occupation of the building(s) evidence (schedule of fittings and manufacturers literature) shall be submitted to the Local Planning Authority and approved in writing to show that the development has achieved an internal water use of 105 Litres per person per day or less.
Reason: In order to protect and conserve water supplies and resources.
Condition : 7 - The development shall not be occupied until evidence (e.g. photographs and copies of delivery notes, invoices or installation contracts) have been submitted to the Local Planning Authority to demonstrate that the development meets the following:
�	At least three of the key elements of the building envelope (external walls, windows roof, upper floor slabs, internal walls, floor finishes/coverings) are to achieve a rating of A+ to D in the Building Research Establishment (BRE) The Green Guide of specification.
�	At least 50% of timber and timber products are to be sourced from accredited Forest Stewardship Council (FSC) or Programme for the Endorsement of Forestry Certification (PEFC) scheme.
�	No construction or insulation materials are to be used which will release toxins into the internal and external environment, including those that deplete stratospheric ozone. 
Reason: In order to ensure the sustainable sourcing of materials.
Condition : 8 - Before the development hereby permitted is first occupied, an Access Road Management Plan shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  The document will include measures to ensure safe access and measures necessary to prevent future obstruction of the access roads within the site by residents or visitors, and informing residents that they will not be eligible for a parking permit in the event a Controlled Parking Zone is introduced in the area. The plan shall be implemented as approved when the first flat is occupied and kept in place permanently.
Reason: To ensure that the development does not prejudice the free flow of traffic or highway safety along the adjacent highway, to ensure the maintenance of safe access to the site and to enhance the pedestrian environment.
Condition : 9 - Development shall be carried out in strict accordance with the Drainage Assessment Form, Ground Investigation Report and associated material approved under permission P/2024/1910. 
Reason: To prevent the risk of flooding to and from the site.
Condition : 10 - No part of the development hereby approved shall be occupied until evidence (photographs and copies of installation contracts, along with a written confirmation) has been submitted to the Local Planning Authority and approved in writing to demonstrate that the sustainable drainage scheme hereby approved has been completed in accordance with the submitted final detailed drainage designs. The sustainable drainage scheme shall be managed and maintained thereafter in accordance with the agreed management and maintenance plan for all of the proposed drainage components.
Reason: To ensure that the methods to mitigate the risk of surface water flooding have been implemented as agreed and that the drainage system is suitably managed.
Condition : 11 - Development shall be carried out in accordance with the landscaping arrangements shown within submitted Drawing 2025_127/001(Rev.C), received on 16/04/2026, which is hereby approved. 
Any trees or plants that, within 5 years of planting, die, are cut down, uprooted, destroyed or become (in the opinion of the Local Planning Authority) seriously damaged or defective, shall be replaced with another tree or plant of the same size and species within the first planting season following its death, removal, uprooting or destruction, unless the Local Planning Authority gives its prior written approval to any variation. 
Reason: To ensure a satisfactory appearance of the site and the adjacent the area, to provide satisfactory levels of play equipment and to enhance green infrastructure, biodiversity and fire safety.
Condition : 12 - Before the development hereby permitted commences:
a. Development shall be carried out in strict accordance with the Phase 1 desk study report approved under permission P/2024/1550. Should the Phase 1 report recommend that a Phase 2 site investigation is required, then this shall be carried out and submitted to, and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The site shall be investigated by a competent person to identify the extent and nature of contamination. The report should include a tiered risk assessment of the contamination based on the proposed end use of the site. Additional investigation may be required where it is deemed necessary.
b. If required, a scheme for decontamination of the site shall be submitted to the Local Planning Authority, for written approval. The scheme shall account for any comments made by the Local Planning Authority before the development hereby permitted is first occupied.
During the course of the development:
c. The Local Planning Authority shall be notified immediately if additional contamination is discovered during the course of the development. A competent person shall assess the additional contamination, and shall submit appropriate amendments to the scheme for decontamination in writing to the Local Planning Authority for approval before any work on that aspect of development continues.
Before the development is first brought into use:
d. The agreed scheme for decontamination referred to in clauses b) and c) above, including amendments, shall be fully implemented and a written validation (closure) report submitted to the Local Planning Authority for approval.
Reason: Contamination is known or suspected on the site due to a former land use. The Local Planning Authority (LPA) therefore wishes to ensure that the development can be implemented and occupied with adequate regard for public and environmental safety.
Supporting notes:
a. An initial phase 1 desk study must be submitted with the original application
Condition : 13 - Before the development hereby permitted is first occupied or brought into use, the Local Planning Authority shall be informed of the agreed naming and numbering of the proposed dwellings so that arrangements can be put in place to ensure that, with the exception of a person eligible for a disabled person's badge issued pursuant to section 21 of the Chronically Sick and Disabled Persons Act 1970 (or similar legislation), no resident of the development shall obtain a resident's parking permit. Any occupiers of the approved development shall surrender any such permit wrongly issued or held.
Reason: To protect the free flow and safety of traffic on nearby highways and to support sustainable transport objectives.
Condition : 14 - Notwithstanding the details on the approved plan, prior to the first occupation of the development hereby approved, advisory signage shall be installed at the site entrance to limit access for vehicles over 3.5 Tonnes. 
Reason: To protect the free flow and safety of traffic on nearby highways and to support sustainable transport objectives.
Condition : 15 - Development shall be carried out in strict accordance with the Controlled Parking Zone Contribution agreement approved under permission P/2024/1550. No residents of the development hereby approved shall be eligible for a permit in any such CPZ.
Reason: To ensure the development avoids unacceptable levels of parking displacement and in the interest of highway safety.
description: Variation of Conditions 1 (Approved Plans), 2 (Materials), 3 (Cycle Parking), 11 (Landscaping) and 17 (Fire Strategy) to allow changes due to building regulation constraints of planning permission P/2025/1358 approved 11/06/2025 for the removal of condition 5c carbon monitoring and variation of condition 6 to a compliance only condition of planning permission P/2024/4200 approved 10/04/2025 for the variation of condition 2 approved plans to reposition the front wall of Unit 9 to allow for a compliant staircase height, to remove the approved planters and replace with planting beds behind a raised kerb and to carry out changes to the garden wall of planning permission P/2022/0025 approved 31/03/2022 for the erection of part 2, part 3 storey building, comprising 9 flats with associated cycle storage, landscaping, refuse and recycling storage.
